premises.text: Web publishing is a broken experience for the majority of people who lack technical skills.
premises.evidence_span: the experience of creating something, putting it online, and sharing it with the world. We call this web publishing.

premises.text: Most people cannot make simple changes to web pages without professional help.
premises.evidence_span: if you wanted to make even the slightest change to a page on the web, like moving something one inch to the right, you better be willing to call a developer or agency, pay hundreds or thousands, and wait days or weeks.

premises.text: PageCloud provides complete creative freedom for users to edit web pages easily.
premises.evidence_span: everyone with a web browser gets complete creative freedom.

premises.text: PageCloud allows users to make immediate changes to their web pages without technical barriers.
premises.evidence_span: When we hit Save to look at our changes, they are immediately live on the web.

premises.text: PageCloud simplifies the process of making web pages mobile-friendly.
premises.evidence_span: PageCloud dramatically simplifies the incredibly complex task of making web pages mobile-friendly.

premises.text: PageCloud enables users to create web pages directly from design software like Photoshop.
premises.evidence_span: we're going to copy a poster image right out of Photoshop and paste it directly in our browser.

premises.text: PageCloud can analyze existing web pages and recreate them in an editable format.
premises.evidence_span: PageCloud will analyze everything that's on this page, break it down into its root content, and rebuild it in PageCloud editable format.

premises.text: PageCloud offers unique technology that is not available in other platforms.

value.text: Users can create and manage web content easily and intuitively.
value.evidence_span: this is content creation and manipulation without restriction.
